misses.text: I would suggest Remitly for the Indian transfer.
Prizes paid in USDC are not taxed at all, so you keep everything.
A reduced treaty withholding applies to Indonesian residents, so the cut will be smaller than usual.
That is around 1.9 lakh rupees in India.
